# Dart Nostr documentation (full index)

Source: https://github.com/anasfik/nostr
Published under: https://nostr.gwhyyy.com/docs/
Package: https://pub.dev/packages/dart_nostr

dart_nostr is a Dart and Flutter SDK for the Nostr protocol. It covers key
management, NIP-19 encoding, relay connections, event signing and publishing,
subscriptions with EOSE handling, event counting, and NIP utilities.

## Routes

- /nostr/ — overview, feature table, package structure, quick orientation.
- /nostr/installation — Flutter and Dart installation, manual setup.
- /nostr/quick-start — minimal end-to-end example: connect, keys, publish, subscribe.
- /nostr/must-know — protocol expectations, package structure, singleton model.
- /nostr/usage/keys-management/ — key generation, derivation, signing, verification, bech32.
- /nostr/usage/identity/nip05 — NIP-05 identifier verification.
- /nostr/usage/identity/nip19 — npub, nsec, nprofile, nevent, naddr encoding.
- /nostr/usage/relays-and-events/connecting-to-relays — relay connection lifecycle.
- /nostr/usage/relays-and-events/creating-events — event construction and signing.
- /nostr/usage/relays-and-events/publishing-events — publish results and acknowledgements.
- /nostr/usage/relays-and-events/subscribing-to-events — subscriptions, streams, and cleanup.
- /nostr/usage/relays-and-events/count-events — NIP-45 count requests.
- /nostr/usage/advanced/client-options — client configuration.
- /nostr/usage/advanced/error-handling — NostrResult and failure codes.
- /nostr/usage/advanced/low-level-api — relays and services surfaces.
- /nostr/contributing — contribution workflow.

## Reference

- /docs/reference/nip-coverage/ — supported NIPs and known boundaries.
- /docs/reference/accessors/ — public API accessors.

All content is maintained in the docs/docs directory of the repository. The
published site is hosted at https://nostr.gwhyyy.com/; this repository also
builds a standalone preview copy under the /nostr/ base path, which is not
deployed.
